method.audio: Authorized low-bandwidth YouTube audio collected with yt-dlp after public caption requests returned 429 or no transcript.
method.review: Full ASR read in chronological order; key windows independently spot-checked against raw ASR. Short paraphrases only.
method.evidence_boundary: These are video-author claims or commentary. They do not prove filmmaker intent or universal rules. Visual claims require separate frame/clip verification.

items.title: The Dark Knight — Creating the Ultimate Antagonist

claims.paraphrase: The video recommends an opponent who can attack the hero's greatest weakness and argues that Joker converts Batman's strengths into liabilities.
Escalating dilemmas force increasingly difficult choices that expose Batman's values and limits.
A matched antagonist repeatedly conflicts with the hero over the same goal; Batman and Joker compete over Gotham's moral order.
A limited, specific and personal threat can be more compelling than generic global destruction.
claims.uncertainty: ASR says fairies where the film context indicates ferries.

claims.paraphrase: The antagonist matters because of a profound, specific effect on the hero and story, not surface unpredictability alone.

items.title: Gone Girl — Don't Underestimate the Screenwriter

claims.paraphrase: Concise action lines can preserve scene tone, intention and pacing even when dialogue changes during production.
The two-word action line 'ugly pause' communicates both tone and rhythm without an unfilmable psychological explanation.
claims.uncertainty: Short quoted phrase; full screenplay version should be checked.

claims.paraphrase: The video frames a scene as a funnel: the beginning states its subject and the final line or action delivers its point and changes the next move.
A subplot character can face the protagonist's problem differently, reveal new information and demonstrate consequences.
Tommy's experience functions as warning and strategy information that changes Nick's later behavior.

items.title: Dan Harmon Story Circle: 8 Proven Steps to Better Stories

claims.paraphrase: The video presents the story circle as eight diagnostic steps rather than a detailed screenplay formula.
You, Need, Go and Search establish a protagonist's stable state, unmet need, active crossing and escalating attempts.
claims.uncertainty: The Dark Knight is used as a retrospective fit.

claims.paraphrase: Find and Take distinguish reaching the apparent goal from paying a severe cost that changes the need.
claims.uncertainty: Step labels are occasionally repeated ambiguously in ASR.

claims.paraphrase: Return carries the consequences into a changed version of the original world.
Change must become visually testable in a final confrontation or mirrored return, not remain explanatory dialogue.
claims.uncertainty: Commentary claim; visual examples not independently frame-checked here.

items.title: Whiplash vs. Black Swan — The Anatomy of the Obsessed Artist

claims.paraphrase: The inciting incident creates a measurable desire that starts the character's change.
Desire becomes consequential when linked to a specific fear; both films use home life to embody feared mediocrity.
A replacement rival and absolute mentor pressure turn escalating obstacles into visible self-destruction.
claims.uncertainty: Do not treat abusive mentorship as real-world advice.

claims.paraphrase: The placement and response to a warning can branch similar structures toward recovery or tragedy.
Both climaxes begin with failure and require a choice that destroys or replaces the old self.

items.title: How Good Filmmaking Brings a Script to Life

claims.paraphrase: The video argues that performance, blocking, editing, sound and framing can be anticipated in screenplay action and rhythm.
claims.uncertainty: No screenplay page number in ASR; page image needs separate verification.

claims.paraphrase: A scene's setup, inciting turn, midpoint, crisis, climax and resolution are expressed through action, silence and distance, not only dialogue.
Observer/observed framing, obstruction, distance and a midpoint push-in turn a power reversal into visible geometry.
claims.uncertainty: Visual claim still requires frame verification.

claims.paraphrase: Silences and short action lines punctuate beats; the duration and placement of pauses shape the scene's rhythm.
claims.uncertainty: Exact screenplay wording not present in ASR.

claims.paraphrase: The midpoint replaces frequent cutting with a long take; footsteps, breathing, blocking and the incomplete count of five steps carry suspense and power.
claims.uncertainty: The claimed 77-second take and five-step effect need clip/frame timing to confirm.

items.title: Drive Opening Scene — How Refn Builds Suspense with Sound Design & Editing

claims.paraphrase: A low controlled rhythm arrives before the first image and preloads tension.
Clicks, stopwatch, alarms and scanner make the time constraint audible and progressively denser.
claims.uncertainty: Layer description should be checked against the original mix.

claims.paraphrase: The police scanner provides off-screen information that the camera withholds.
A brief lull subtracts sound to hold breath, then off-screen scanner information releases the uncertainty.
A high swell and rising level mark renewed vulnerability and acceleration while the image remains comparatively restrained.

items.title: See With Your Ears: Spielberg And Sound Design

claims.paraphrase: Sound can assign a viewpoint that differs from the camera by selectively bringing street, car and target sounds forward.
claims.uncertainty: Author comparison, not a controlled published experiment.

claims.paraphrase: A long scene can progress with ambient bed and isolated narrative sounds rather than score or dialogue.
claims.uncertainty: Claimed scene duration and mix need source-film verification.

claims.paraphrase: Competing environmental sounds can mask critical information before one sound is isolated as the next clue.
Tension can grow by subtracting elements until the expected explosion is represented by silence.
Restoring reverb, footsteps and sirens after the silent climax reopens space and consequence.

items.title: Jackie Chan - How to Do Action Comedy

claims.paraphrase: Action comedy builds from disadvantage and uses familiar environmental objects in unfamiliar actions.
claims.uncertainty: Selected examples; visual proof requires clips.

claims.paraphrase: Clear contrast and stable framing let action and reaction share a frame and preserve geography.
Action rhythm is rehearsed and performed, not created only by faster cuts.
claims.uncertainty: No production documentation beyond quoted examples.

claims.paraphrase: A hit can be shown in a wide and then repeated in close-up with a brief registration offset so the mind combines it as one stronger event.
claims.uncertainty: The three-frame example must be frame-checked before treating it as exact.

claims.paraphrase: Visible pain humanizes the hero, while persistence and a concrete payoff complete the action-comedy contract.

items.title: BEWARE! This video is EVIL — How to Build Suspense with Shot Composition

claims.paraphrase: Relative size in the frame can assign visible power or weakness.
claims.uncertainty: Qualitative principle, not a fixed ratio.

claims.paraphrase: Telephone and television are framed larger than the character as the threat gains control.
Negative space and a high angle isolate and diminish the vulnerable protagonist.
A foreground puddle and oversized doorknob delay the reveal while making the threat larger than the protagonist.
claims.uncertainty: Visual size and pause need frame/clip verification.

claims.paraphrase: The summary recommends enlarging the threat and diminishing the protagonist at peak vulnerability.

items.title: 6 Ways to Edit Any Scene — Essential Film & Video Editing Techniques Explained

claims.paraphrase: Editing decisions can be framed as what to show, when to cut and what to cut to.
An eyeline match links a character's attention to an object; delaying or withholding the object creates intrigue.
Cross-cutting can braid concurrent locations and create parallel or escalating action.
claims.uncertainty: Concurrency must be established per project.

claims.paraphrase: Eye trace preserves a focal region across cuts so short action clips remain readable.
claims.uncertainty: The cited 1.8-second example is not a universal threshold.

claims.paraphrase: J- and L-cuts let sound lead or trail image to smooth dialogue, reactions and plan-to-execution transitions.
Cutting within an action can connect direction and force when exit and entry moments match.
claims.uncertainty: Exact cut should be tested against generated material.

items.title: How to Write 1 Hour TV Pilot for Netflix, HBO, Amazon (PART 2) - 5 Act Structure & A,B,C Stories

claims.paraphrase: A pilot should keep a clear A-story goal and obstacle, with only a small number of interwoven supporting lines.
claims.uncertainty: One writer's teaching framework, not platform policy.

claims.paraphrase: The A story should build across the pilot toward a cliffhanger that creates a next-episode question.
The five-act model moves from ordinary setup through inciting disruption, midpoint loss or false victory, renewed responsibility and final escalation.
claims.uncertainty: Page counts and act proportions are not universal.

claims.paraphrase: Supporting lines should return as obstacles or responsibilities that directly press the A-story.
A B/C line belongs in the pilot when it raises A-story stakes and can merge into a moral choice or crisis.
claims.uncertainty: Do not mechanically label every relationship as a subplot.

claims.paraphrase: The final act can resolve the immediate surface problem while revealing a larger task or cost that becomes the cliffhanger.
Editing, camera movement, sound and music jointly calibrate pacing so large tonal shifts remain coherent.
Montage accelerates a repeated con pattern while solving the information-budget problem of a more complex plan.
Every shot supplies information or foreshadowing; slow motion, linear movement and music make the sequence a rhythmic unit that manipulates time.
Two performances can be stitched within a camera move when neither take supplies the desired tempo alone.
claims.uncertainty: Specific edit claim; frame-level verification required.

claims.paraphrase: Intercutting locations removes repeated lines and makes multiple places feel like one bouncing conversation.
The montage's apparent control also plants material that later recontextualizes the family's success.
